description: Create a text frame on a page of a master spread. Position and size are in mm from that master page's top-left corner.

alignment.description: Paragraph alignment for the frame text (InDesign Justification; LEFT_JUSTIFIED = justified, last line left)

fontName.description: Font as "Family\tStyle" (e.g. "Arial\tBold", InDesign's Font.name) or a family name

isPrimaryTextFrame.description: Make this the master spread's primary text frame

masterPageIndex.description: 0-based page within the master spread (0 = left/first page)

textColor.description: Text color: swatch name in the document (e.g. "Black", "Paper", "None") or "#RRGGBB"

name: create_master_text_frame
title: Create Master Text Frame
